---
title: "Start JupyterLab"
---

## Use the workshop route

From the DNAnexus project interface, use:

**Tools → JupyterLab → New JupyterLab**

DNAnexus exposes other ways to launch applications, but this tutorial uses the dedicated JupyterLab route throughout.

## Recommended settings

For the training exercises, use:

| Setting | Recommendation |
|---|---|
| Project | Your MCPS training/workshop project |
| Snapshot | Leave blank |
| Cluster | Single Node |
| Instance Type | `mem1_ssd1_v2_x4` |
| Feature | `PYTHON_R` |

DNAnexus displays an **Estimated Price** before you start the environment. The exact amount depends on the configuration and session duration.

::: {.callout-note}
## Cost awareness

JupyterLab uses compute resources while the environment is running. Check the estimated price before starting, and terminate the environment when you have finished.
:::

## Wait for the environment to become ready

The environment normally moves through an initialization/queueing stage before it is ready to open.

Once it is **Ready**, open the JupyterLab environment.

::: {.callout-important}
## Do not close the browser and assume the compute has stopped

When you finish working, explicitly terminate the JupyterLab environment.
:::
